key_insight: An augmented variational framework yields second-order solitary-wave formulas for the extended KdV equation, recovering classical KdV results in the first-order limit.
engineering_relevance: The closed-form wave-speed and amplitude relations provide a practical reduced-order tool for predicting solitary waves and dispersive shock edges in dispersive hydrodynamics.
method: Build a master (augmented) Lagrangian modeled on Luke’s formulation
Enforce eKdV constraints with Lagrange multipliers at the correct asymptotic order
Average the Euler–Lagrange equations in a traveling-wave setting to derive a sech^2 solitary wave and explicit second-order parameter formulas
evidence_signal: The derived solitary-wave and dispersive-shock predictions were compared against direct numerical simulations and reported to be in strong agreement.
watch_item: The formulas are asymptotic and tailored to the eKdV regime, so accuracy may degrade outside the assumed ordering or for strongly nonperturbative dynamics.
paper_title: The Extended KdV Equation: Augmented Lagrangian and Variational Solitary Waves with Applications to Dispersive Hydrodynamics
